name: Princess'Lords
source:
The player controls a peasant who takes revenge on the country that has forsaken him upon coming into possession of a demonic ring and gaining power over an army of demons. Three princesses rise to oppose him, but all will be humiliated.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/268927/]MobyGames[/url]]
